description: Add a customizable text watermark to any photo — choose position, opacity, size, color and angle, preview live, then download.

faqs.a: Nine anchor positions (corners, edges, center) plus fine-tune offsets. Drag-and-drop is not needed — the grid covers the common cases.
faqs.q: Where can the watermark be placed?

faqs.a: Yes — the angle slider rotates the watermark from -90° to 90°, and the tile option repeats it across the whole image for stronger protection.
faqs.q: Can I rotate or repeat the watermark?

faqs.a: A diagonal tiled watermark at low opacity is the hardest to remove. Corners at high opacity also work well.
faqs.q: What makes a watermark hard to remove?

faqs.a: No — the watermark is drawn and saved locally in your browser.

howto: Type your watermark text and pick a position.
Adjust opacity, font size, color and angle (or enable tiling).
Preview live, then download the watermarked PNG.
title: Watermark Adder
